messages:
pagerbot: ALERT: Canary group 'wave-3' reporting elevated 5xx rate (5m agg 12.4%, threshold 5%). Healthcheck failures on 3/6 nodes. service=frontend-infer region=us-west-2
devon: Ack. I'm looking. Which feature flag rolled here? :eyes:
sophia: That was ff_infer_v2 enabled ~6m ago for wave-3.
kevin: I'm seeing corresponding increase in latency + dropped connections in LB logs. Quick snippet: 
kevin: ```
# tail -n 50 /var/log/lb/front.log | grep 502
... 2026-03-17T02:18:43Z - 502 - /v1/generate
... 2026-03-17T02:20:01Z - 502 - /v1/generate
```
devon: Can we kill the flag for wave-3 only? If not, abort rollout and rollback to previous model.
sophia: ff-service supports targeting. I'll flip ff_infer_v2 -> off for wave-3 now. `/ff toggle ff_infer_v2 --target=wave-3 --off`
infra-bot: COMMAND: /ff toggle ff_infer_v2 --target=wave-3 --off
infra-bot: SUCCESS: Flag toggled. Propagation to ~300 nodes in 40s.
kevin: Metrics already trending down. 5xx now 4.1% (5m). Keep an eye for reappearances.
devon: Good. Let's also drain the new model pods and roll back canary image to `image:stable-2026-03-10`. @emily please take over post-mitigation monitoring and customer comms.
emily: Got it, taking handoff. I'll open an incident ticket and ping CS for potentially impacted customers.
sophia: Runbook: create incident ticket, severity=P2, include flag toggle + rollback steps, upload logs to s3://redwood-incident-archives/6298765432. I'll trigger the logs dump now.
devon: Thanks team. If errors drop below 1% sustained for 10m we can close. For now rollout is blocked and product is notified.
kevin: Pager cleared for me but I'll stay on standby for 30m.
emily: Handoff done. Summary: killed ff_infer_v2 for wave-3, rolled back canary image, 5xx decreased from ~12% -> 3.8% within 6 minutes. Customer impact: subset of API requests in us-west-2 may have seen 502s between 02:18-02:24 UTC. CS notified and a brief status update posted to customers. :white_check_mark:
